The activity is concentrated around the port-quarter; which is the bottom-left corner of the vessel. This suggests that the engine room was struck, most likely by a US Hellfire missile. There are no signs of fire or smoke on thermal imagery. The vessels do not appear to be conducting firefighting operations at the time of the image, although those efforts may have concluded before 07:21 UTC, when today's imagery was captured. We also have sources reporting that NITC’s STARK1 (9171450) was struck off the coast of Kooh Mobarak, Iran overnight. She too is empty of cargo.
